round3.question: n5-g022 (今、何時ですか。) had exKana いまなんどきですか and was IN the dictation pool; round 3 corrects it to なんじ (docs/measurements/v135-residue-manifest.json). Why did no instrument catch なんどき, and may the corrected sentence stay in the pool? Audio caches were outside the repo (DICTATION_WAV_CACHE=~/Library/Caches/NihongoRide-v135-work/r3-wav).

whyTheInstrumentsMissedIt.candidateSet: Every instrument tests only readings it is offered. Sudachi's lookup of 何時 gives いつ and なんどき, never なんじ, and no headword 何時 adds it from the corpus, so なんじ — the standard reading — was never a candidate for this sentence (build_rows subs: 今 -> こん, 何時 -> いつ).
whyTheInstrumentsMissedIt.instrument1: silent: the whole-kana rendering いまなんどきですか (3328b22946b5) is not byte-identical to the exJP audio (b0ef718b85a7), nor is いまいつですか, and いまなんじですか (096f13c54fa2) was never rendered by it.
whyTheInstrumentsMissedIt.instrument2: not flagged: exKana なんどき 0.1303 against its only rival いつ 0.1314 (log-mel DTW), so なんどき was 'nearest'. Rendered here, the untested なんじ sits at 0.0772 and would have beaten both. Its calibration (100% recall, 0% false positives against instrument 1's labels) holds for readings it is offered; a reading outside the candidate set is the case its own docstring says it cannot order.
whyTheInstrumentsMissedIt.sudachi: Sudachi SplitMode A and C both tokenise 何時 as ナンドキ here, which is where the corpus reading came from: 4ceba24 (v1.18 A) generated it with gen_sentence_kana from Sudachi's ナンドキ, and 7f71a3d (v1.18 B) carried it into the punctuation-free exKana (git log -S'"なんどき"' -- n5.json finds 4ceba24; -S'いまなんどき' lands on 7f71a3d only because it dropped the punctuation). The corpus agreeing with Sudachi is one blind spot, not a confirmation — the same shape as 何:なん and 金:きん in rounds 1 and 2.

calibration.positiveControl: instrument 1 proved 39 sentences say their corpus reading; 1b contradicts 0

n5-g022.detail: 1b confirms 今 = いま (いま、何時ですか。 byte-identical, b0ef718b85a7) but never confirms the disputed 何時: neither 今、なんじですか。 (4f19f171322a) nor 今、なんどきですか。 (2aa5dfeba8ef) nor 今、いつですか。 (9429d39c5c00) renders byte-identical to the exJP audio. A release requires the disputed word to be confirmed, so the verdict is SILENT. Instrument 2 on the corrected tokens does not flag it (own なんじ 0.0772, nearest rival 0.1287), and the span comparative favours なんじ (0.0273 against なんどき 0.0771 and いつ 0.0652) — both leads, not verdicts. A further lead, from both round-2 refuters and reproduced in round 4: 何時 rendered ALONE is byte-identical to なんじ (e5d02abc4b49), not to なんどき (854997343a9e). That proves how Kyoko reads the word in isolation, not what she says in this sentence, where 1b stays SILENT, so it is a lead for the word and not proof for the sentence: the withhold stands.

round3.decision: WITHHELD. The sentence was in the pool on instrument 2's not-flagged, and that verdict is void: it was reached without the standard reading among the candidates, and the exKana it described no longer exists. The only calibrated proof instrument is silent on 何時, and silence is not evidence in either direction, so the one-sided policy withholds it (a false withhold costs one N5 sentence of dictation; a miss marks a learner against audio nobody proved). Before this correction the pool graded against なんどき, which the voice almost certainly does not say. Recorded in dictation-reading-mismatches.json as undecided.
